card.title: Requirement
card.run_completed_not_done: Run completed; the requirement is not done yet.

participants.stale: Participants changed. Review the latest revision before saving.

candidate.attachments_unavailable: Some selected attachments are not present in the source preview. Approval is unavailable.

approval.title: Approve requirement
approval.consequence: Creates one Issue and starts the agent. Review later changes in that Issue; start a new chat for an independent request.
approval.stale: The candidate or revision changed. Review the latest candidate before approving.

review.title: Review
review.cancel_consequence: Stops execution and keeps the existing Chat and Issue links.
review.accept_consequence: Marks the Issue done and publishes this summary, its Issue link, and the selected source status.
review.result_placeholder: Delivered changes, validation results, and artifact links...
review.accept_stale: The Issue changed. Close this dialog and review the latest version.

intake.title: New requirement
intake.idea_placeholder: Remember me on the login page
intake.idea_hint: Creates a 易协作 draft, then opens a requirement Chat to clarify it.
intake.source_hint: Creates the requirement from an existing source. It does not open a new draft.
intake.no_agent: No agent can take this requirement.
intake.send_unconfirmed: The last submit is not confirmed. Retrying the same idea will not create another draft. Discarding it and writing a new idea may create a duplicate.
intake.unknown: The draft result is not confirmed. Do not create another one.
intake.too_long: The idea must be at most 20000 bytes.
intake.handoff_pending: The draft is saved. The Multica handoff is not finished.

intake_settings.consequence: Choose a default source template for this robot. Each member independently selects ordinary chat or requirement flow with /mode; leaving this empty uses the built-in template. In requirement flow, new ideas create 易协作 drafts; clarify and approve in Multica Chat.
intake_settings.save_failed: Could not save the requirement entry.

flow.title: Requirement flow

next.clarify: Add the missing goals, scope, and acceptance criteria below.
next.clarify_viewer: The requester adds the remaining details; execution starts after approval.
next.working: Working on it — wait before looking for approval.
next.awaiting_candidate: Waiting for the next candidate to review.
next.approve: Review the candidate, then create the Issue and start the agent.
next.execute: Follow progress or add information in the linked Issue.
next.blocked: The requested participant must reply in the Issue's question thread.
next.review: Accept the delivery or request changes.
next.unknown: Read the latest requirement before continuing.

flow.sync_alert: Source sync needs attention. Expand Details to handle it.
